test_objective: Check that you can update a scope in an entity

test_cases.name: 011_05_01 Update scope to an entity already having a scope
test_cases.doc: Check that scope is replaced if entity already has a scope
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/'
        method set to 'GET'
        Request Retrieve Entity by Id and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: accept set to 'application/json' and
    Query Parameter: context set to 'https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld'
}

test_cases.name: 011_05_02 Update scope to an entity not having a scope
test_cases.doc: Check that scope is not added if entity does not already have a scope
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/'
        method set to 'GET'
        Request Retrieve Entity by Id and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: accept set to 'application/json' and
    Query Parameter: context set to 'https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld'
}
